name: GCP Compute Engine — Instances
description: Pull GCP Compute Engine instances as cloud workloads for CNAPP inventory and posture analysis

steps.instruction: Open GCP Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts
Create a new service account (or select an existing one) and grant the 'Compute Viewer' role
Click the service account → Keys → Add Key → Create new key → JSON, then open the downloaded file
Copy the value of 'private_key' (the full PEM block including headers)

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to GCP Compute Engine. Verify the service account has the Compute Viewer role on the project.

transform.expr: True if any((ac.get('natIP') for ni in (record.get('networkInterfaces') or []) for ac in (ni.get('accessConfigs') or []))) else False
